text:
Anika-CS: Heads up — Spruce (trial customer) hit hard throttles during a live buyer demo in the UK this morning. They need a short, controlled QPS/egress lift and an IP allowlist for the demo window, otherwise the procurement meeting tomorrow might get pushed.

Jamal-Spruce: Yep, sorry — this was our fault for running parallel load tests before the demo. Demo is 2025-04-12 14:00-16:00 UTC. Can we get ~1,200 QPS for that window and allow 34.89.120.0/24 outbound to eu-west-2? We only need it for the 2h demo.

Anika-CS: Renewal conversation is scheduled with their CFO right after the demo; if the demo fails they'd probably delay the PO. Trying to avoid churn.

Tom-SRE: Ok. We have a temporary-burst process. I can cut a limited-time rule but need the org id + exact CIDR + whether they need streaming or embeddings.

Jamal-Spruce: Org: spruce-delphi-prod. CIDR: 34.89.120.0/24. Workload: chat streaming heavy (many short streams). QPS target: 1,200 peak, sustained ~800.

Tom-SRE: Thanks. Setting up plan:
1) Add allowlist for 34.89.120.0/24 to egress policy for eu-west-2 edge nodes
2) Temporarily raise per-org QPS ceiling to 1,500 and per-route soft-limit to 1,200 for the demo window
3) Auto-revoke at window end + notify ops channel

Tom-SRE: Will do this as a scoped change (no infra restart). I need a ticket so the change is auditable. @ops-bot can you create one with the following JSON payload?

ops-bot: Creating ticket TEMP-EGRESS-1718012345 in queue customer-success.

Tom-SRE: Payload (paste to ticket):
```
{ "org": "spruce-delphi-prod", "cidr": "34.89.120.0/24", "region": "eu-west-2", "start": "2025-04-12T14:00:00Z", "end": "2025-04-12T16:00:00Z", "qps_ceiling": "1500", "route_soft_limit": "1200", "reason": "Customer live buyer demo; renewal/PO at risk" }
```

Anika-CS: Please add a note to the ticket saying "revocation confirmed at end-time; ops to verify 30m after". Also include contact: jamal@spruce.ai and +44 7700 900123.

Tom-SRE: Got it. Implementing change now. Will post logs and the rule id here.

ops-bot: TEMP-EGRESS-1718012345 created by ops-bot. Assigned to tom-sre. SLA: 1h.

Tom-SRE: Rule applied -> rule_id=r-0a9f2ebc, allowlist applied to eu-west-2, qps ceiling set. I verified streaming paths are covered.

Anika-CS: Incredible, thank you! Can you also enable token-level cost logging for that org during window? We want to capture delta for chargeback and to show value to the CFO.

Tom-SRE: Enabled token-cost trace for spruce-delphi-prod from start to end window. Will dump the aggregated CSV to the ticket after demo.

Jamal-Spruce: Huge relief — thanks team. We'll run a short warmup at 13:50 UTC.

Tom-SRE: Note: change will auto-revoke at 2025-04-12T16:00:00Z. I'll post a final confirmation and the revocation log here at 16:05 UTC.

Anika-CS: Fingers crossed. If anything spikes unexpectedly, ping me directly and I'll escalate. :crossed_fingers:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 15 minutes before start.

Tom-SRE: (after) Revoke complete. rule_id=r-0a9f2ebc removed at 2025-04-12T16:05:12Z. Aggregated token delta and cost CSV attached to TEMP-EGRESS-1718012345.

Anika-CS: Customer said demo went well, CFO asked for the cost delta report — shared it in the renewal packet. Thanks all. :tada:

Jamal-Spruce: Thank you everyone. We'll proceed to finalize PO.

Anika-CS: Closing ticket and adding a short postmortem -> note: communicate warmup guidance to customers ahead of demos and add a self-serve "ephemeral demo lift" doc in onboarding.

Tom-SRE: +1 to doc. I'll add a short SRE-runbook for these requests so we can do them faster next time.
